integrity.proof_scope: The finite graph, facets, 422 legal collapses, 17-edge spanning tree and 92 triangle generator reductions are fully specified in the included certificate.
integrity.reproducibility: Run python3 verify_pappus_cech.py with certificates/pappus_cech3.json; standard library only.
integrity.scientific_status: Constructive self-contained proof with self-review; no independent external validation or certification.

scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy type is established only for the Pappus graph at intrinsic Čech scale three.
The proof combines exhaustive elementary-collapse and van Kampen certificates with standard integral homotopy theorems.
No claim is made about all cubic girth-six graphs, full persistence or a canonical equivariant basis.
Possible unindexed or uninspected equivalent prior work remains a bibliographic risk.
title: The scale-three graph Čech nerve of the Pappus graph is a wedge of forty-four two-spheres
